items.title: sgl-project/sglang released v0.5.18
items.title_zh: SGLang v0.5.18 发布：新增模型支持与性能提升
items.title_en: SGLang v0.5.18 Adds New Models, Boosts Performance
items.summary: SGLang v0.5.18 is a major release adding support for multiple new models and incorporating contributions from over 200 contributors.

items.title: Munder Difflin – Agent harness to run an office of your clones
items.title_zh: Munder Difflin：让AI编码代理克隆体组成办公室协同工作
items.title_en: Munder Difflin Runs an Office of Your Coding Agent Clones
items.summary: Munder Difflin is a local multi-agent harness that wraps around existing coding agent subscriptions to run deterministic simulations of agent offices, reducing token usage while orchestrating multiple LLM roles.

items.title: I developed my own quantized LLM from scratch, trained on 30B tokens, deploys in 60 MB [R]
items.title_zh: 开发者从零训练量化LLM，部署体积仅60 MB
items.title_en: Developer Builds 60 MB Quantized LLM From Scratch on 30B Tokens
items.summary: An LLM trained from scratch on 30B tokens, quantized to under 2 bits, achieving 60 MB deployment and 400 tok/s CPU inference with a novel disk-based long-context retrieval mechanism.

items.title: I built an open-source roguelike specifically for training game-playing agents [P]
items.title_zh: DelveRL：专为训练智能体而生的开源Roguelike游戏
items.title_en: DelveRL: Open-Source Roguelike for Training RL Agents
items.summary: DelveRL is a new open-source roguelike designed specifically for training game-playing agents, featuring deterministic simulation, batched environments, and a baseline reaching floor 18-33.

items.title: SemiAnalysis：开源模型加速追赶，每代追平时间减半
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis：开源模型加速追赶，每代追平时间减半
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis: Open Models Close the Gap Twice as Fast Each Generation
items.summary: SemiAnalysis finds that open-source models are catching up to closed frontiers twice as fast with each generation, now matching top models within months and threatening the commercial value of model layers.
